# EVIT Organization

> EVIT Organization helps B2B IT service providers, software development companies, and technical founders build predictable sales pipelines, expand globally, and win international clients through sales consulting, lead generation, market entry strategy, and sales team enablement.

## Core Services

- [Global Expansion Service](https://www.evitconsulting.com/services/global-expansion-services): market entry planning, international sales channels, ideal client profile, positioning, and execution support.
- [G.O.D. Sales System](https://www.evitconsulting.com/services/sales-growth-system): a sales system for IT service providers that want predictable sales execution instead of founder-led or referral-only growth.
- [B2B Marketing and Lead Generation](https://www.evitconsulting.com/services/marketing-service): conversion-focused marketing funnels, content, lead generation, and automation for technology companies.
